bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.description: Holds 9 tiles of water (3 bricks). Left: scoop from still water, or fill from a source. Right: pour a brick.

source_bucket.name: Source bucket
source_bucket.description: Carries one source brick, water or lava. Left: take a source. Right: put it down as a spring.

water_source.name: Water source
water_source.description: Creative: pours an endless water source in every stud of the block.

water_brick.name: Water brick
water_brick.description: Creative: pours still water, 3 tiles a stud.

lava_source.name: Lava source
lava_source.description: Creative: pours a lava source in every stud of the block.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: Holds 27 stacks. Place it, then right-click it to open.
